title: 流れ学Ⅰ
subtitle: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics I
keywords: Fluid properties 2.Fluid statics 3.Basic fluid mechanics 4.Bernoulli equation 5.Local collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamentals of fluid dynamics and aerodynamics (2) learn the fluid properties of air because aircraft fly in the air (3) learn the measurement principles of fluid devices (4) learn fundamental equations and their application
advice: This is a fundamental fluid dynamics and aerodynamics course. Students will learn fluid properties, fluid statics, inviscid flow, and incompressible flow. We will cover the following materials: 1. Fluid properties and flow phenomena: units and dimensions, fluid properties, fluid statics 2. Forces and moments on a body: pressure, hydrostatic pressure, manometer, buoyancy 3. Fluid and body dynamics: fundamentals of fluids, continuity equation, Bernoulli equation 4. Laws of similarity: flow similarity, dimensionless numbers (Reynolds, Mach numbers) Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses. Students are expected to solve the exercises by themselves to understand the course. Students are also expected to review their notebooks for better understanding. Students are expected to actively participate in the presentation and discussion.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Industrial Mechanics I and II. Sufficient skill in mathematics and physics (dynamics)

activityGoals.body: Be able to express fluid properties, particularly density, viscosity, pressure etc.
Be able to calculate forces and moments acting on a body due to pressure
Be able to calculate the total pressure applied to an object
Be able to explain Mach and Reynolds numbers
Be able to calculate fundamental fluid computation using continuum and Bernoulli equations
